input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-t5, as V = Qe * tau from the CO2 rise at reduced speed and the decay at full speed.

steps.why: Rise: reduced effective flow (about 0.3 m3/min) lets the occupants' CO2 climb from 1300 ppm toward a higher equilibrium; about 300 ppm expected in 30 min for a first guess V=30 m3.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min) and record the decay toward its equilibrium; first-guess tau = 30 min. Fit only after about 10 min (3 scrubber lags) from the step change.

abort.source: scrubber.motor.state: CO2 of the lab, co2-1-t5
abort.when: CO2 of the lab at or above 3000 ppm
the device refuses a step's speed command
battery state of charge under 40 percent
a monitored person out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the lab

monitoring.reason: The two occupants of the lab breathe the raised CO2 during the test.

expected.start: co2 about 1300 ppm at the start, headroom above the 200 ppm start margin to the 3000 ppm abort.
expected.rise: With V about 30 m3 (first guess, fitted default 10 to 200), 2 occupants awake at 0.38 L/min each (0.76 L/min) and Qe about 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent, C rises from 1300 toward an equilibrium near 2500 ppm with tau about 100 min: about +300 ppm (about 1600 ppm) after 30 min, never above 2500 ppm. A rise under about 100 ppm or a flat curve shows a larger V, an active leak, or occupants not producing the assumed CO2.
expected.decay: At full speed, Qe = 1 m3/min, tau = V/Qe about 30 min for V = 30 m3; C falls from about 1600 toward about 760 ppm, to about 1130 ppm after 25 min. V_lab = Qe * tau from the fit of C(t) = C_eq + (C_0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau).
expected.hypothesisCheck: co2_habb stays flat (within sensor noise) if the closed hatch exchanges no significant air; a co2_habb that follows the lab shows exchange and the fitted V is biased high. A co2_lab that does not converge to a single-tau exponential (residuals, or different V in rise and decay) shows poor mixing or a changed source: occupants moving in or out invalidates the curve.

hypotheses: The lab is one well-mixed zone; the CO2 sensor co2-1-t5 represents its mean concentration.

The hatch to hab-b is held closed during the whole test; the exchange through the closed hatch is not measured (design ventilation 3 m3/min hatch closed is a documented figure, not assumed zero) and is read from co2_habb.

The two occupants stay in the lab at constant activity (awake, 0.38 L/min each, range 0.26 to 0.45) during the test; the source is not measured, only the time constant is used, so V = Qe*tau does not depend on it.
The effective flow Qe is the datasheet value 1 m3/min at full speed and scales linearly with speed; the scrubber lag of 3.33 min is discarded from the fit.
Outdoor air/leak exchange of the lab is negligible.
